moduleTitle: Toolchain, Types, Errors, and Control Flow
title: Toolchain, Types, Errors, and Control Flow Phase Assessment
description: Comprehensive phase-end assessment covering all lessons in Toolchain, Types, Errors, and Control Flow.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of modules?

options.text: initialize and commit go.mod
modules define an import path and dependency boundary
changing module identity breaks import assumptions
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: initialize and commit go.mod. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of gofmt?

options.text: format before review and tests
gofmt applies canonical source formatting
manual formatting conventions create needless drift
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: format before review and tests. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of packages?

options.text: use package main with main for executables
a package groups compiled declarations
imported package names must be used
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: use package main with main for executables. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of zero values?

options.text: design useful zero values where practical
every declared variable receives a type-specific zero value
zero does not always satisfy domain invariants
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: design useful zero values where practical. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of short declarations?

options.text: use it for clear local initialization
:= declares at least one new local name
it is unavailable at package scope
The runtime automatically repairs the program

questions.explanation: use it for clear local initialization. Confirm with gofmt, go test, and a focused program.
